plain: A standard test of how good a chat model is at ordinary helpful tasks, scored out of 10 by a strong model acting as judge.
eli5: A report card for how helpful a chatbot is, with grades from 1 to 10.
technical: An 80-question, two-turn benchmark across eight task types, graded 1–10 by GPT-4 as an LLM judge (Zheng et al. 2023); HarmBench uses it once, as the capability cost of R2D2 (Zephyr 7B 7.34 → 6.0).
